systems.system: co-ordinated connectivity building for public services in rural areas
systems.owner: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Technology, as the policy's author
systems.tiers: a stated strategy, not a deployment: connectivity for schools, clinics, police stations, libraries and local authorities in rural areas, to give the public access there

note: Passages file. No fact: the National ICT Policy and Strategy 2019-2024 names police stations once, in a list of rural public services whose connectivity is to be co-ordinated; that is enabling, and nothing is said about station records or any police information system.
